headline: Colonial Counterattacks Shake Weathered Expanse as Mooring County Lines Shift
war_summary: Since our last dispatch, the northern theatre has witnessed significant counter-strokes, with Colonial forces clawing back vital ground across Weathered Expanse and Mooring County. In the Weathered Expanse, where eleven base actions unfolded in the past two hours alone, the territory now splits into four Colonial positions, three Warden strongholds, and two abandoned ruins amid relentless clashes around Wightwalk. Mooring County similarly saw its front lines reshape, yielding four base turnovers over two hours to leave Colonials holding three bases against nine Warden garrisons. Farther south in Callahan's Passage, three rapid handovers were logged near Crumbling Post despite overall casualty rates thinning to a bare trickle. Nevish Line endures brutal attrition, tallying over seven hundred casualties in two hours across its five-to-three partition without recording an immediate territorial shift. Palantine Berm and Kuura Strand have settled into quiet consolidation under full Warden administration, while accelerating fire in Stonecradle and Dead Lands suggests fresh friction along dormant sectors.
